remarks: Welcome to luxury living at The Biltmore! Located on the 12th floor, this freshly painted 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condominium features a spacious open floor plan with breathtaking sunrises and expansive city views. The modern kitchen is equipped with wood shaker cabinets, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar, while engineered hardwood floors flow throughout the home. The large bedroom includes a custom walk-in closet and direct access to the double-entry bathroom. Residents enjoy premium amenities such as a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, shuttle to the train, community room, laundry, storage, dry cleaning, and a pet-friendly environment. Secure garage parking is available for $118 per month per car. Located in the heart of Downtown Stamford, with easy access to I-95, Metro-North, and Bedford Street, this turnkey residence offers the ultimate in city living!
